description: Designed, analyzed, and eventually developed the MVP web application for a Platform as a Service provider.
Collaborated closely with our SysAdmin to utilize Docker and its automation capabilities, enabling us to grasp the requirements and having a clearer picture of our needs.
Collaborated and on-boarded our new frontend developer to enhance UI's beauty.
Implemented the Auth module for an ECommerce web app with the help of my senior team lead.
Engaged in system analysis and design, contributing to the development of the software.
Conducted a Proof of Concept for full-text search in PostgreSQL, showcasing my problem-solving skills and ability to identify and evaluate potential solutions.
Close collaboration with other colleagues in order to complete tasks and tickets.
Developed a matchmaking system, which relieved the sales team of a tedious task; finding the right cabinetmaker for each customer based on the parameters they had.
Refactored a large portion of the codebase from JavaScript to TypeScript, contributing approximately 40% of the migration effort.
Advocated for adopting NestJS, helping modernize the backend stack and improve maintainability.
Researched, and learned Ansible in order to configure servers smoothly and automate tedious tasks.
Developed the backend for a ticketing system and an apartment booking, and then collaborated with frontend engineers to deliver best possible UI/UX.
Successfully configured an Ubuntu server and Nginx, enabling smooth deployment and maintenance of web applications.
Developed a custom wrapper for Partocrs in NestJS, making it easier for us to work with Partocrs.
Engaged in technical discussions with my team lead and my peer devs to stay in touch with the new technologies and ways of doing things.
As the security champion for my team, I took ownership of ensuring the safety of our software.
Collaborated closely with product and engineering teams to quickly gain domain knowledge and contribute effectively to climate-focused software solutions.
Provided technical guidance on MongoDB data modeling and query optimization, helping improve the team's understanding and usage of the database.
Applied Test-Driven Development (TDD) to improve code quality and facilitate predictable deployments.
Identified and removed duplicated business logic by introducing reusable abstractions and shared interfaces.

Designed and implemented performant RESTful APIs focusing on scalability, idempotency, and real-world client usage patterns. Advocated for standards-compliant API design by leveraging HTTP semantics and RFC guidelines to improve consistency, reliability, and developer experience.
Led the design and implementation of an event-driven production workflow, replacing a synchronous integration approach and helping reduce technical debt while improving service autonomy.
Led the migration of a business-critical feature between services, improving ownership boundaries and providing valuable insights that informed subsequent architectural refactoring efforts.
Designed and implemented a proof of concept using RabbitMQ, applying Outbox and Inbox patterns to evaluate fault-tolerant asynchronous communication.
Strengthened software delivery quality by promoting automated testing practices and implementing Jenkins pipeline guardrails that helped identify issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
Collaborated to shape & evolve GraphQL APIs with a strong focus on developer experience, usability, and performance while considering their impact on database efficiency and scalability
